Suggested multi-slot agenda (virtual, 60/60/45/30 + debrief blocks):
1) 09:30–10:30 — Systems design (interviewer: Karthik)
2) 10:45–11:45 — Distributed systems / performance (interviewer: Laura)
3) 12:15–13:00 — Live coding (pairing, marker: Marissa)
4) 13:15–13:45 — Behavioral / culture (panel: Mateo + Marissa)

- Debrief rhythm: fast initial thumbs (5 min) then full debrief 20 min after loop. Proposed debrief owners: Marissa — behavioral owner; Karthik — technical owner; Mateo will take exec readout.
- If any interviewer cannot do the contiguous block above, propose a specific alternate time (we prefer not to exceed two separate gaps for the candidate).

Thanks — please reply with confirmations/suggested slot swaps.
